bugs.root_cause: A live credential was copied into project documentation instead of using a placeholder.

bugs.root_cause: The test script invokes tsx, but tsx is not listed in devDependencies and is not available in the local environment.
bugs.fix: Not fixed in this audit; recommended adding tsx as a devDependency or changing the test runner command.
